prevention.title: What NASA PSI records show on prevention

findings.text: SPICE recorded 435 tests with gas fuels at 21% oxygen (assumed cabin air).
ACME CFI-G recorded 333 tests with gas fuels, 179 of them with an oxygen value from 18% to 40% (measured).
ACME/Flame Design recorded 327 tests with gas fuels, 207 of them with an oxygen value from 19.8% to 40% (measured).

prevention.implication: Solid-material tests in PSI stop below the 30% oxygen expected in a lunar base, so prevention findings need checking at lunar conditions.
prevention.gap: No partial-gravity combustion data is in PSI yet.
problems: gap says nothing went out at lunar oxygen, but the facts record extinctions at 30% oxygen or more

detection.title: What NASA PSI records show on detection

findings.text: SAME-R recorded 109 tests with solid fuels at 21% oxygen (assumed cabin air).
SAME recorded 20 tests with solid fuels at 21% oxygen (assumed cabin air).
DAFT / DAFT-2 recorded no individual tests with dust fuels.

detection.implication: Solid-material tests in PSI stop below the 30% oxygen expected in a lunar base, so detection findings need checking at lunar conditions.
detection.gap: No partial-gravity combustion data is in PSI yet.

suppression.title: What NASA PSI records show on suppression

findings.text: FLEX recorded 274 tests with liquid fuels at 12% to 34% oxygen (measured).
BASS-II recorded 129 tests with solid fuels at 13.6% to 22.2% oxygen (measured).
BASS recorded 121 tests with solid fuels at 21% oxygen (assumed cabin air).

suppression.implication: Solid-material tests in PSI stop below the 30% oxygen expected in a lunar base, so suppression findings need checking at lunar conditions.
suppression.gap: No partial-gravity combustion data is in PSI yet.
